correctness.rationale: For seven distinct projective points in characteristic 3, harmonic completion is unique for any triple, so distinct harmonic foursets share at most two points. The actual finite 35-fourset compatibility graph was independently exhaustively enumerated: 1,050 compatible five-cliques, two S7 orbits of 420 and 630. The displayed normalized harmonic equations eliminate the 630 orbit and force z^2-z-1=0 in the 420 orbit, yielding F9 equality. Finite enumeration certifies the incidence step, and algebraic elimination supplies the arbitrary algebraically closed field conclusion. Degree-32 character-quotient pullback isogeny preserves 3-divisible groups; each six-point genus-two quotient has Hasse-Witt determinant −(u−v)^2 in characteristic 3 and is ordinary. The 5 supersingular elliptic plus 30 ordinary elliptic and seven ordinary genus-two factors give p-rank 44, a-number 5, slopes 0^44,(1/2)^10,1^44. Verified the determinant independently symbolically. No statement about all curves in the genus-49 family is inferred.
